setup.box: [x,y,width,height,material], integer cells, positive dimensions, half-open extent
setup.disc: [x,y,radius,material], integer circle dx*dx+dy*dy<=radius*radius, clipped to extent, radius2..24
setup.overwrite: ordered last write wins; Empty0 erases
setup.rectangles: nonempty equal-material horizontal runs coalesced vertically only while start,width,material match

generated_start.exact_identity: material bytes SHA256, JSON-roundtripped recipe SHA256, generator fingerprint/revision and receipt identities; not arbitrary image bytes

materials.stone13: movable Powder; can be temporarily supported; never count as permanent masonry
materials.wall1: immovable hard surface; generic acid kernel explicitly skips it
materials.reinforced_concrete58: immovable hard surface; generic acid can dissolve it
materials.hard_surface_rule: explicit capability table; broad Solid classification does not imply collision, e.g. Plant11/Fungus18 are not hard surfaces
materials.static_rule: immovable does not imply chemically permanent; inspect kernel, pair rules and exposed materials
materials.generic_acid_rule: after attempted movement, lifecycle sample dissolves any neighbour except Empty0, Wall1 or Acid12; native/src/world.cpp4109..4130
materials.thermal_rule: hot Fire6/Lava8/Spark34/MoltenGlass36 can ignite combustible material; Ice9 melts near hot material; pair reactions add more transformations
materials.rooting_limit: fixed-cell solid structures do not structurally fall solely because visually disconnected; permanent-support/rooting is a conservative authored-composition criterion, not a simulated engineering-strength claim

midge.spawn: exact saved x,y enters Setup.physical_definitions and rig body placement; no nearest-point substitution
midge.admission_limit: whole hull must be inside extent, but native development placement deliberately admits hard-terrain intersections; successful installation alone is not proof of an unobstructed spawn
midge.collision: actual RectangleShape2D size=part.size, RigidBody2D CCD_CAST_SHAPE, Rapier terrain from native hard-surface cells
midge.envelope_policy: retain all declared conservative envelope tests; report actual4x3 hull separately; no replacement or relaxation after seeing outputs

native_availability.download: exact accepted Linux LFS object fetched successfully
native_availability.limits: local Linux experiment only; no owner-machine, Windows or GPU-playfeel claim; incomplete native testing remains NATIVE-UNTESTED without stopping the experiment
